data.long_meaning: Ushaanj is a unisex name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Usha' meaning dawn or morning. It is associated with the Hindu goddess Usha, the personification of dawn. The name Ushaanj carries the meaning “Morning Dawn” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ushaanj usually hope their child will grow to embody morning dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
